status: MP13 PIN HOLE COUPON v1 - test piece for the steel dowel holes of the MP6 cycloid reducer; values here are test sizes, not fits (fits live only in src/cad/calibration/print-fits.json)
decision: .dev/mp13-evidence/user-decisions-mp13.json - user 2026-11-04: the FIT_STRIP pin holes 3.8 / 3.9 / 4.0 / 4.1 were all too small for the real Ø4 dowel ('가장큰것도때려야지 겨우겨우들어가 거의안들어간다고봐도 무방') -> question box '0.05 간격 8 개 (권장)' · 'MP13 (권장)'
holes_note: left -> right = small -> large; 4.10 repeats the largest FIT_STRIP hole as a reference between the two prints
plate_note: through holes, printed flat (hole axis = z, like the reducer parts). Push a dowel in from the TOP face = the base / carrier press holes (they open upward when printed); from the BOTTOM face (bed side) = the cap slip holes (the cap prints with its pin holes opening on the bed). Thickness 10 > the cap slip depth 6.65; the base press depth is 21.85 so the press feel here is per 10 mm.

print.note: same as the reducer parts and the fit ledger's PLA rows - print the coupon with the filament (and nozzle) the housing / carrier will be printed with

check_note: C2 reads each hole's area-equivalent diameter from STL sections at z = 2 / 5 / 8; a fine-tessellated circle reads a little under the design value, inside the tolerance
